FORMAL SCIENCE / EVIDENCE-SEMANTICS REVIEW — BLOCK

Reviewer: codex-mockup-science-review
Candidate: cand-3CM1JDY29SG3WPSV74GVS08WNF
Exact commit: dda53463a1556f1b18bfd8a24c937d439fc89dfc
Tree: 7fd21caf66b562c48c635ba38844ad00ffd7303b
Direct parent/base: 003f12b21e1b9793fea479e104c2e2eff3e55fe5
Reviewed scope: mockups/mockup-v2-design-brief.md and mockups/v2 only
Pinned scientific provider checked: storymodel4s 3cf704a743d251b0ca09a3238b059e41883370af (build.sbt:32)

Method

I reviewed a fresh git-archive export of the exact candidate, independently verified commit/tree/direct-parent and scoped diff, reran verify-manifest.cjs and fixture-court.cjs, inspected the authored sources and original-resolution frozen plates, executed the Main claim data across every selection, and compared all claimed AlignState vocabulary with the exact pinned storymodel4s source. I made no edit, staging change, authorization, landing, or push.

Verdict

BLOCK. S3 and S4 pass, and the chronology / field-addressability portion of S5 is substantially repaired. Two S2 evidence-contract defects and one S5 cross-view epistemic contradiction remain. These are representability and auditability failures, not aesthetic preferences.

S2 — BLOCK: full AlignState and unbalanced semantics

PASS: RecallMatrix.dc.html:110-114 correctly scopes row sums of 1.00 to this synthetic fixture and says AlignmentRow permits unbalanced producer output. External(SourceConsistentInference) and External(Unranked) are now named canonically rather than collapsed into a source state or residue. Source and Distorted mass at one anchor are visually separate.

BLOCK S2.1 — the advertised canonical facet cannot exist at the exact provider pin.

The pinned enum at align/src/main/scala/storymodel4s/align/facets.scala:17-18 is exactly:

Actor, Action, Object, Location, Outcome, Cause, Context, RoleReversal, Polarity, Modality

There is no Facet.Attribute. Yet the candidate asserts Distorted(s05,{Attribute}) as an exact AlignState in RecallMatrix.dc.html:341-342, FIXTURE-NOTES.md:70-78, StateBoard.dc.html:148-158, and the acceptance-bearing brief at mockup-v2-design-brief.md:558-561. The same invalid identity is frozen into the review plates. This is not merely a friendly label: the candidate says the facet set is part of typed state identity and travels with its mass. At the exact provider revision, that state cannot be constructed or parsed.

If the intended error is about the remembered object, use a supported facet such as Object only if the declared source/recall assessment warrants it; if Action also conflicts (“took” versus “pushed”), name that explicitly if warranted. If a new Attribute facet is scientifically necessary, it requires a storymodel4s vocabulary/ADR decision before the mockup claims it as canonical.

BLOCK S2.2 — r03's state mass and evidence prose disagree, and the alleged context distortion is unsupported by the exact recall.

RecallMatrix.dc.html:343 gives r03 no explicit Distorted state; its generic mass is converted at lines 512-520 to Source(s02)=.46, Source(s04)=.21, and External(SourceConsistentInference)=.28. The exact recall is “his uncle told him the other side was empty,” which preserves a reporting frame. Nevertheless lines 544-549 call “Reported as fact” a conflict, and line 571 says the unit “asserts the content as fact.” That is contradicted by the exact words “told him.” Under the pinned Facet.Context contract, the canonical Bartlett distortion is promotion of reported/believed/intended content to narrated fact; this recall does not do that.

The defect is also structural: line 559 exposes the conflict facet table only when selAlign is Distorted, so r03's conflict table is unreachable while line 592 still shows its incompatible-world prose for the selected Source(s02) state. This directly violates the plate's own line-114 contract that fidelity facets remain part of Distorted-state identity rather than a tooltip detached from mass. Supplying an otherwise unspecified teller is not automatically a contradiction, and the row already has SourceConsistentInference mass available for a source-consistent supplied detail.

The inspector also uses friendly strings Role, Attribute, and Reported as fact at lines 536-557 where the exact enum keys are RoleReversal, no Attribute, and Context. Friendly descriptions are acceptable only when the canonical facet key remains visible and the prose is explicitly an alias/explanation.

S3 — PASS: feature conservation, typed policies, missingness

fixtures.json:18-55 contains one authoritative 117-token lexical ordinal ledger. Independent recomputation gives exactly 92 observed + 25 missing = 117, sentence coverage sums to the same totals, and the selected [41,66) window gives 21 observed + 4 missing = 25. Main.dc.html:308-309 and 333 render those exact values. The declared vocabulary is EdgePolicy.KeepPartial, ScalarReducer.Mean, IgnoreMissing, MissingReason.AllMissing, and MissingReason.ProviderAbstained. I independently perturbed a selected-window observed value, a sentence observed value, and a missing ordinal; all three conservation mutations were killed. No 103/117 residue remains.

S4 — PASS: proposed-only Universe state and MemoryAddress conservation

fixtures.json:104-105 records sourceState=Unestablished with sourceStateContract=proposed-storyatlas-view-state@v1. FIXTURE-NOTES.md:100-109, StateBoard.dc.html:272-278, and the Interview plate state plainly say this is a proposed StoryAtlas compiler/view state and that the pinned provider has no such type. The twelve detail rows preserve all eight MemoryAddress dimensions, including Discourse and Unresolved; source coverage is uncomputable, not rendered as zero. No intrinsic memory-address category is collapsed into a view-only scope.

S5 — PARTIAL PASS, but BLOCK on one cross-view epistemic contradiction

PASS: Main.dc.html:212-260 now declares a story-world partial-order rank rather than a clock. s01/s03/s04 occupy an explicit incomparable band; no s03-before-s04 edge is asserted. s02 remains reported content, and the s02/s09 portal is only opposite-polarity recurrence with identity and persistence explicitly unestablished.

PASS: Independent execution across s01-s10 exposes 37 unique addressable claims: 21 SurfaceExplicit, 13 Hypothesized, 2 LinguisticallyEntailed, and 1 StructurallyDerived. All upstream claim ids resolve; exact source spans round-trip; SurfaceExplicit claims have source support; the three alternative groups retain two distinct members each; no claim value collapses alternatives. The existing span mutation is killed.

BLOCK S5.1: Main.dc.html:486-491 tells the analyst “He→Erran is StructurallyDerived,” while the field-addressable registry at line 643 records that exact resolution, c-s03-agent-erran, as Hypothesized. Both appear for s03 in the same inspector state. Those statuses make different epistemic claims and cannot both describe the same field. Choose the warranted status and use it everywhere; the current evidence/upstream-only coreference record appears deliberately weaker, but the repair must make that decision explicitly rather than relying on this review's guess.

Proof-boundary gap

The passing courts do not cover either blocking shape. export.cjs:598-658 validates that a claim status belongs to an allowed vocabulary, but it does not compare summary prose with the field-addressable claim it describes. fixture-court.cjs validates feature conservation and spans, but it does not validate mockup facet names against the exact pinned provider enum or require every displayed conflict to be carried by a Distorted state. Because these are string fixtures, compileAll cannot catch the nonexistent Facet.Attribute.

Minimum successor acceptance

1. Replace Attribute with a scientifically warranted set drawn from the exact pinned Facet enum, or first land an authorized provider vocabulary change. Preserve Source(s05)=.30 versus Distorted(s05,{...})=.41 as distinct state masses.
2. Remove the unsupported r03 “reported as fact” conflict, or use different exact recall evidence that truly promotes reported content to narrated fact and encode Context inside an explicit Distorted state with its own mass.
3. Require every displayed wrong facet to be present in the selected Distorted state's identity; a Source state must not render incompatible-world prose or a hidden conflict table.
4. Make c-s03-agent-erran's status identical in summary prose and the claim registry.
5. Add killing mutations for an unknown facet name, a conflict detached from Distorted mass, and a summary/claim status mismatch. The facet court must be bound to the exact provider vocabulary, not only another unchecked local string list.

No authorization, landing, or push is implied. The independent implementation review also has its own separate block; this post records only the scientific/evidence disposition.
